cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your garden gnome is coming home in a different arrangement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Several pieces, carefully packed. I wanted you to hear 'coming home' first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Most pieces are here, and we can start with the smile.

mechanism: A manages the order and emotional focus of difficult truth, using assumed authority to reveal increasingly serious facts while steering B toward what can still be kept.
confusable: Distinguish mere euphemism from staged disclosure that changes prior reassuring words and serves to cushion B, rather than solely protect A from blame.
comparison: Wedding venue loss preserves date as an anchor; broken gnome preserves return and repairable smile as anchors.
seedUse: Canonical venue/fire and gnome/pieces seeds supply staged truth; S01 should control focus and next action, with B questions determining what is disclosed next.
